name: ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QM5A 23.8 Inch FHD Fast IPS 240Hz Gaming Monitor
shortDescription: ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QM5A 23.8 Inch Full HD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (1920x1080 Resolution / 240Hz Refresh Rate / 1ms GTG 0.3ms Min Response Time / HDR10 Support / 99% sRGB Color / NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible & AMD FreeS
descriptionHtml:
ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QM5A 23.8 Inch Full HD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (1920x1080 Resolution / 240Hz Refresh Rate / 1ms GTG 0.3ms Min Response Time / HDR10 Support / 99% sRGB Color / NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible & AMD FreeSync Premium / ELMB Sync / Built-in 2W Speakers / DisplayPort 1.4 & HDMI 2.0 / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Elevate your competitive esports gameplay with the ASUS TUF Gaming VG249QM5A Gaming Monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Featuring a 23.8-inch Full HD (1920x1080) Fast IPS panel with ultra-wide 178-degree viewing angles, this display boasts a blazingly fast 240Hz refresh rate and down to 0.3ms minimum response time for buttery-smooth performance. Packed with top-tier gaming features including Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync (ELMB Sync), NVIDIA G-SYNC compatibility, AMD FreeSync Premium, VESA AdaptiveSync 240Hz certification, HDR10 support, 99% sRGB color gamut coverage, integrated stereo speakers, and low blue light hardware safeguards.
